A '''Pop'N'Drop''' was an Advanced level [[Bank (swoopchasing)|Bank]] [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]] used in [[swoopchasing]]. Riders rode up an incline of forty-five degrees to the apex topped by a [[Gate (swoopchasing)|Gate]] Fence. Past the peak, riders had to guide their [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] over a chasm of thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]], dropping ten to fifteen meters in height to land on the opposite side. The pit in the middle of the Pop'N'Drop was usually filled with spikes and dropped one hundred meters. A variation of the Pop'N'Drop was the [[Suicide Peak]].<ref name="BSS" />
